name: Paris UX designer seeking genuine product-design scope

context.employment_state: Recent contract ended; portfolio ready and actively applying
constraints: Digital product design with discovery/research and delivery
Remote roles must accept France-based work
Relevant midlevel scope, not automatic senior/lead substitution
context.company_awareness: Knows some French product companies but starts from role scope and working arrangement

trigger: Opens several design results that either focus on marketing graphics or describe remote work unavailable from France.

searches_run.observation: Retrieval returned category pages mixing product design, UX/UI, research, senior roles and contracts. Direct inspection of Welcome to the Jungle's category also included a software-engineer title, demonstrating that a matching category is not exact occupation proof.

searches_run.query: product designer remote France user research full remote France only
searches_run.observation: The batched retrieval included remote-labeled design listings and generic remote community posts, without conclusive France-residence eligibility. Following a remote-labeled Yubo listing exposed concrete product-design duties but also two required office days monthly despite the full-remote summary label.

sources.title: Product Designer Paris — Indeed
sources.supports: Retrieved category combines product/UX-related titles; result counts do not measure genuinely suitable openings.

sources.title: Product Designer à Paris — Welcome to the Jungle
sources.supports: Directly inspected category displays mixed seniority, contracts, telework labels and a software-engineer entry; illustrates the need to inspect role details.

sources.title: Mobile Product Designer — Yubo
sources.supports: Directly inspected employer-authored listing describes discovery, experiments, prototypes and product collaboration, requires three to four-plus years, and states two office days monthly beneath a full-remote summary. Country eligibility is not fully resolved.

best_entry_page.promise: Show how to assess product-design responsibilities and France-compatible remote conditions from actual job descriptions, with unknown or contradictory details called out.
best_entry_page.cta: Chercher des rôles et comparer les critères
proof_needed: Source-linked examples distinguishing research/discovery from visual production
Remote label checked against office attendance and country wording
Missing residence or employment eligibility left unknown
Do not treat Figma mentions as sufficient product-design proof
New indexable guide; current search pages are noindex

conversion_objections: Will this return graphic designers just because design appears in the title?
Does remote mean France is accepted and how often must I visit an office?
Can I search in both French and English without losing relevant roles?
I already have a portfolio; I do not want another portfolio course.
Will midlevel results be swamped by senior or lead positions?
Can description matching show its evidence rather than only a score?

avoid_targeting.query: product designer work from anywhere guaranteed
avoid_targeting.reason: Work mode does not establish country eligibility or unrestricted mobility.
This experienced applicant has a completed portfolio; training is not the need.

message_to_founder: Simulation : Mon portfolio est prêt ; je veux savoir si le poste comporte vraiment de la recherche, des décisions produit et du travail avec les développeurs. Et si vous affichez télétravail, montrez-moi les restrictions pour quelqu’un qui reste en France.
confidence_and_limits: Synthetic persona. Two queries were submitted together; their combined retrieval is not a controlled ranking report and individual-result attribution is limited. Direct category and employer-listing inspections supplied the concrete mismatch. Other queries are hypotheses. No country eligibility, job availability, coverage or language requirement is guaranteed. The observed remote-summary/body inconsistency is one example, not a prevalence estimate.

search_journey.fit_reason: Occupation and location search fit if coverage exists.
Role search is useful but description scope needs review.
